rules.statement: The prescription period for an action without a written agreement is three years from the date of the cause of action.
rules.supporting_quote: In the case of an unwritten agreement, an action should be filed within three years from the breach of the said agreement (from the date of the cause of action), in terms of section 7 of the said Ordinance.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 7 of the Prescription Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 as amended
